generation_evaluation.note: LLM output is measured only when generation_mode is llm. Deterministic fallback results are never labeled as LLM results.

history_evaluation.note: Repeatable golden evaluation never queries configured external history. Snowflake is covered by opt-in integration tests.

business_outcomes.note: Business scenarios in the demo are illustrative, not measured outcomes.

metric_definitions.task_success_rate: Fraction of scenario runs satisfying all declared expected outcomes.
metric_definitions.grounded_answer_accuracy: Verifiable expected text and source citations for chat scenarios.
metric_definitions.answer_quality_accuracy: Declared directness, uncertainty, completion, citation, and claim-safety checks for chat scenarios.
metric_definitions.claim_citation_relevance: Fraction of chat runs whose inline claims have substantive, non-contradictory support from their cited source snippets.
metric_definitions.unsupported_claim_avoidance: Fraction of chat runs that omit every scenario-declared unsupported claim.
metric_definitions.required_evidence_accuracy: Fraction of chat runs returning every scenario-declared source and document requirement.
metric_definitions.action_safety_rate: Controlled mutations obey confirmation, idempotency, staleness, and authorization expectations.
metric_definitions.latency: Warm in-process timing; excludes model download and dashboard rendering.
